HOME SCIENCE — TERMLY EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 0 °C

2. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Producers
   D. Tertiary consumers

3. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety in the Home? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety in the Home.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Safety in the Home.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety in the Home.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety in the Home.

5. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

6. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Housing the Family? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Housing the Family.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Housing the Family.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Housing the Family.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Housing the Family.

9. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. newton (N)
   C. joule (J)
   D. pascal (Pa)

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Kitchen Layouts and Equipment? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Methods of Cooking? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Methods of Cooking.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Methods of Cooking.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Methods of Cooking.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Methods of Cooking.

12. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Milk souring

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in ? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in .
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in .
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in .
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in .

15. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Glucose and oxygen

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutritive Value of Foods? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Nutritive Value of Foods.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutritive Value of Foods.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutritive Value of Foods.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutritive Value of Foods.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Sewing Tools, Equipment and Materials and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Textile Fibres 3.3 Clothing Construction Processes: Stitches 3.4 Clothing Constr and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
